name: blitz
notes: Raster-only (no PDF backend): renders one W x H CSS px viewport at scale 1 on white to PNG; --margin-px is ignored. Renderer: anyrender_vello_cpu 0.19.0 VelloCpuImageRenderer (CPU only, no multithreading feature, as in the WPT runner). page_rule=false: no pagination/@page. default_page_size_config=true means the viewport size is taken from --page-width-px/--page-height-px (blitz_traits::shell::Viewport::new, packages/blitz-traits/src/shell.rs:103). Setup mirrors wpt/runner/src/test_runners/mod.rs:293-344 (DocumentConfig + HtmlDocument::from_html + resolve/pump loop) and wpt/runner/src/renderer.rs:411-422 / examples/screenshot.rs:108-133 (white fill + blitz_paint::paint_scene into VelloCpuImageRenderer). blitz-dom feature set copied from wpt/runner/Cargo.toml:16 (floats and writing-mode are non-default, packages/blitz-dom/Cargo.toml features). image codecs png/jpeg/gif/webp added by the adapter because blitz-dom depends on image with default-features=false (Cargo.toml workspace image entry; decoding at packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:617-650 via image::ImageReader::with_guessed_format, SVG fallback); all codec crates are already in upstream Cargo.lock. local_resources: adapter-provided synchronous NetProvider (blitz_traits::net::NetProvider, packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs:19) reading file:// and data: URLs, modeled on wpt/runner/src/net_provider.rs; base URL is the input file's file:// URL; resolve loop repeats until no new fetches and BaseDocument::has_pending_critical_resources() is false (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1403, resolve drains loaded resources at packages/blitz-dom/src/resolve.rs:46). system_fonts: blitz-dom system-fonts feature -> parley/system (fontique + fontconfig); BaseDocument::new builds the font collection with system_fonts=true (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:409-432); needs libfontconfig1-dev as in upstream .github/workflows/wpt.yml. font_face: @font-face via FontFaceHandler (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:307-360), WOFF/WOFF2 via woff feature (wuff). geometry: element boxes from BaseDocument::get_client_bounding_rect (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2491), border box in CSS px relative to viewport, DOM pre-order over Node.children, node label tag#id.class. diagnostics=false: Stylo error_reporter is hard-coded None (packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:173, net.rs:286, document.rs:1310-1326), adapter writes {"unsupported":true}. javascript=false: blitz-vibey-script (Boa) exists in the workspace but is not used by the adapter. svg: inline <svg> and SVG images via blitz-dom svg + blitz-paint svg (anyrender_svg/usvg). No rust-toolchain.toml upstream; workspace rust-version 1.91.0, edition 2024.
